headline.text: Cat 301.5 mini excavator with canopy. Northridge walks you through start-up and the controls at handover.

quick_start_text.text: Before operating, go through start-up and the controls with Northridge staff at handover. Cat's Operation and Maintenance Manual is linked under Manual.
quick_start_text.status_reason: Northridge policy; no Cat operating steps are written without the manual.

safety_notes.status_reason: Cat's safety rules come from OMM M0088895, not bought (operator decision, 2026-10-17).

troubleshooting_notes.text: Something wrong (a warning light, leak or odd noise): stop safely and use Request Support.

return_notes.text:
Return the keys and any attachments.
Northridge photographs the machine at handover and at return.
Use Return checklist when you drop it off.
return_notes.status_reason: Return checklist template and Northridge policy.

emergency_notes.text: For emergencies call your local emergency number. For equipment issues, use the support contact on this page.

documents.title: Cat 301.5 Operation and Maintenance Manual M0088895 (sold by Cat Publications; search M0088895)
documents.status_reason: Cat's official channel. Cat Publications has no stable product link (its search is a form), so the title names the media number.

showcase.narrative: Staff take outbound photos at handover, then a return checklist flags new damage with photos and staff review and resolve it. One renter damage report arrives without photos, and the record shows exactly what was and wasn't captured.
showcase.limitation: It shows when something was recorded, not who caused it.
